_note: Draft customer requirements derived from the re-engineering KPIs. Process owners validate them with the customer.

01.requirement: Know whether budget is available before committing spend

04.requirement: A quick, comparable go/no-go decision on each land deal
04.measure: Working days from opportunity logged to go/no-go

05.requirement: Only sell units that are legally sellable
05.measure: Reservations made before License to Sell

06.requirement: Progress billing verified and approved promptly
06.measure: Days from cut-off to approved progress billing

09.requirement: A correct Contract to Sell, ready to sign quickly
09.measure: Days from reservation to notarized CTS

11.requirement: An accurate, current statement of account

12.requirement: Cancelled units back on sale quickly
12.measure: Days from effective cancellation to re-listing

13.measure: Days from equity fully paid to loan release

16.requirement: Paid on a predictable schedule, with BIR 2307
16.measure: Ad hoc payment runs per month

17.requirement: Commission paid on time, with a clear statement
17.measure: Days from release trigger to payout

19.requirement: Title delivered promptly after full payment
19.measure: Days from full payment to title delivery

X2.requirement: One consistent management pack, early each month
